Settings General tab has season input, subscription amount, trial rule toggles, save button
Settings Paiements tab has payment method list with add/remove functionality

context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features working correctly: Settings page has 6 tabs (General, Paiements, Produits, Caisse, Evenements, Depenses). POS whitelist in Caisse tab controls which subcategories appear in POS. Product categories are stored as dict with subcategory arrays. Product image upload works via multipart form to /api/products/{id}/upload-image. Dynamic payment methods from settings appear in POS. Test session 'test_session_1776359528327' is valid.

settings_tabs.details: 6 tabs: General (season, subscription, trial rule), Paiements (payment methods), Produits (categories with subcategories), Caisse (POS whitelist), Evenements (event types/formats), Depenses (expense categories)

pos_whitelist.details: Checkboxes in Settings > Caisse tab control which subcategories appear in POS. Auto-saves on toggle. Empty whitelist shows all products. Products without subcategory show under 'autres'.

product_image_upload.details: Image upload zone in product create/edit dialog. Supports JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF up to 5MB. Images stored at /api/uploads/products/{product_id}.{ext}. Thumbnails shown in product table and POS.

dynamic_payment_methods.details: Payment methods from settings appear in POS checkout. Can add/remove methods in Settings > Paiements tab.

subcategory_grouping.details: POS page groups products by subcategory with uppercase headers (BOISSONS, SNACK, etc.). Products without subcategory grouped under category or 'autres'.
